sourceFile: 6. MSU-L20S15-07 Report test reverse direction magnetic CMG_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not usable because the changed factor, evidence citations, statistics, and spec judgements are materially wrong or ambiguous.
issues: Changed factor is misclassified as supplier/material; source indicates magnetic direction change/function check.
Baseline and changed/test conditions are not explicit from cited rows.
Evidence omits title and sample result rows, citing mostly headers/specs.
Stats and sample counts do not match visible sample rows.
Spec failures and Sigma NG results are ignored as zero violations.
requiredUserQuestions: Is this report testing reverse magnetic direction against normal direction, or only checking reversed samples?
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to magnetic direction change/reverse CMG, not supplier/material.
Use Sheet1!3 plus header/spec rows and all sample rows as evidence.
Recompute metrics from actual visible sample rows only.
Apply specs N 400-570G and S 390-590G and count out-of-spec/NG results.
Merge duplicate measurement outcomes into one validation outcome with Gauss, Sigma, Hearing, and remarks.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Current citations are insufficient; final evidence must include title, spec, and sample result rows.
